title: ontology-texture-embeddings: code and ontologies for "When Does an Attribute Ontology Help Frozen Foundation-Model Embeddings? Evidence from Texture Retrieval, Classification, and Clustering"
description: Code and hand-curated attribute ontologies (DTD: 47 attributes in 8 families; KTH-TIPS2-b: 11 materials in 4 families) for combining frozen DINOv2, CLIP and SigLIP embeddings with an ontology through enriched prompts, retrieval re-ranking and ontology-guided clustering.
